title: Steel Bridge Fabrication in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel footbridges, plant bridges and pipe racks fabricated by Steel Mind Engineers in Pakistan. Designed for load, span and long service life.
h1: Steel Bridge Fabrication in Pakistan: Footbridges, Plant Bridges and Girder Spans
quickAnswer: Steel bridges are light, strong and quick to install. Steel Mind Engineers fabricated and erected a 150-foot water requirement bridge for M/S Yascon at Petaro Cantt, Sindh.
alt: Steel pedestrian footbridge over a canal in Pakistan.

faq.q: Can a steel bridge be moved?
faq.a: Bolted bridges can be taken apart and moved, if planned that way.

faq.q: How long does a steel bridge last?
faq.a: With good coating and maintenance, many decades.

blocks.text: Steel bridges are light, strong and quick to install. The parts are made in a factory and lifted into place, which reduces road closures and site work.

Pedestrian footbridges span roads, canals and drains. Plant and conveyor bridges are steel walkways and supports between buildings. Girder bridges use steel girders with a deck for light vehicle or equipment loads.

The span and width set the depth of the girders. Choose the load from the people, vehicles or equipment that will use the bridge. Bridges stay outdoors, so the coating system matters. See Painting. The crane size and the lift plan must also fit the site.
Steel Mind Engineers built a water requirement bridge at Petaro Cantt, Sindh. The bridge is 150 feet long, 6 feet wide and 30 feet high, with an area of 900 square feet.
